intent: Correct corner geometry per user: square large panels; one small top-left cut on portrait; paired cuts only on small controls with detached square-completing L brackets.

refinements.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ONLY these small shape corrections in the supplied game UI screenshot. Preserve the rest pixel-faithfully: same aspect ratio 21:9, composition, type, costs, rank icons and positions, ownership checks, illustrations, color palette, plain rectangular outer panel and row panels, and all text.

1. The TOP LEFT PORTRAIT frame: a rectangle with only ONE TINY TOP LEFT cut, about 10 pixels. Its RIGHT edge must run straight vertically all the way to its BOTTOM edge. Its BOTTOM RIGHT corner MUST be a perfectly square 90-degree corner, with no diagonal, no chamfer and no clipped art. Its bottom-left and top-right corners must also be perfectly square. Fill back any cut lower-right portion of the portrait and its frame. Do not change the character or placement. Do not make an octagonal portrait.
2. Under the three capstone icons, retain the amber words "AT RANK 5" but DELETE the enclosing capsule outline and DELETE all notched/angled decorative underline strokes beside those captions. Leave just plain text. Any nearby row divider must be a single straight thin horizontal line without a notch.
3. The small rank and capstone icon tiles should retain their paired tiny top-left and bottom-right diagonal cuts, but every cut MUST have a separate ivory right-angle corner piece completing the original full rectangular corner: ┌ at top left and ┘ at bottom right, with a visible 3-pixel dark gap from the diagonal. Correct any corner where the bracket is missing or fused to the diagonal into a triangle. Do not change card size, move icons or change their states. This completes the square silhouette of small controls.
All large panels and artwork frames remain plain square-cornered rectangles. No additional cuts or decorative shapes. Keep text and art unaltered. Output the whole corrected screenshot, not a crop or comparison.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the A02 HUD-themed upgrade roadmap.
Image 2 is the approved live HUD, especially the bottom-left portrait, whose single small top-left cut is the ONLY portrait shape to copy.
Image 3 is the critical construction reference for small cut-corner controls. It shows that their missing top-left and bottom-right corners are COMPLETED by detached right-angle bracket pieces, so their total visible footprint still reads as a full square.

Make a targeted geometry correction only. Preserve Image 1's approved layout, panel sizes, positions, all three roadmap rows, all six columns (five ranks plus capstone), illustrated art, all text, exact spelling, all costs, ownership checks, selected Unyielding preview, and the underlying battlefield. Keep its restrained near-black charcoal and ivory treatment. Do not redesign or rearrange the layout.

THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: The interface overall must be rectangular and square-cornered. Cut corners are a sparse motif for small controls, not a general panel style. Apply these exact rules:

1. MAIN MENU CONTAINER: a clean ordinary rectangle with four intact square 90-degree corners. Straight top, bottom, left and right edges. REMOVE every diagonal cut, staircase, notch, beveled wing, clipped outer corner, and decorative geometric nib from the main outer silhouette. Keep its fine ivory outline and subtle inset line. Do not round the corners. Keep battlefield margin all around.

2. HEADER: ordinary rectangular header space. No clipped nameplate, no trapezoid shelf, no angled rule ends, no angular PAUSED placard. The title, name, LV14, 4SP and PAUSED remain in the same locations, separated with fine straight rules.

3. PORTRAIT: essentially a true rectangle. Exactly ONE SMALL 45-degree cut at the TOP LEFT, about 8% of the portrait width. The top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left corners are completely intact square 90-degree corners. Keep the original portrait placement and art. NO hexagon or octagon framing, no cut bottom-right, no slanted sides, no large chamfer slicing off her face. This should look like the small bottom-left portrait in Image 2.

4. LARGE CONTENT AREAS: the three illustrated WEAPON/SPECIAL/BURST panels at the left, the rank heading cells, the lower artwork, the preview-text panel, and footer ALL have square corners and straight rectangular frames or simple straight divider lines. Remove all cuts from these large elements. Keep the artwork itself intact. The small "AT RANK 5" captions are plain text with no chamfered capsule or notched underline.

5. SMALL INTERACTIVE CONTROLS ONLY: the small rank-icon tiles, small capstone-icon tiles, and UPGRADE WEAPON button may use exactly TWO very small 45-degree cuts, TOP LEFT and BOTTOM RIGHT. Their other two corners stay square.
MANDATORY FOR EVERY SUCH PAIRED CUT: add a separate bright ivory L-SHAPED CORNER PIECE in the space outside each diagonal. The top-left piece is a visible ┌ shape; the bottom-right piece is a visible ┘ shape. Each sits at the original uncut rectangular outer corner, with both legs extending toward the main outline. A visible dark gap separates the L piece from the diagonal cut. The combined diagonal tile + detached right-angle bracket creates a COMPLETE SQUARE/RECTANGULAR SILHOUETTE. Image 3 shows this exactly. These are not tiny decorative marks on the wrong corner: they reconstruct BOTH missing corners. Make the detached L pieces clearly visible at screenshot scale, roughly 8–10 px long with a 2 px ivory stroke and 3–4 px clear gap. Never leave a paired diagonal cut without its matching detached square-completing bracket. No triangles, extra arrowheads, gold corner wedges, or filled diagonal bits.
The outer rectangle of each rank tile should look complete at a glance. Let the rank icons remain white, unlocked checks pale mint, future icons subdued. Keep the selected capstone identifiable with a tiny amber tick, not a gold perimeter.

6. KEYCAPS: normal dark rectangular key tabs with ivory outlines. No new large cuts. Color discipline unchanged: charcoal / ivory / muted gray, small amber accents only. Do not introduce gold-filled panels or glowing cyan borders.

EXACT CONTENT TO PRESERVE:
"ABILITY RANKS"; "SNOW WHITE | LV 14 | 4 SP"; "PAUSED".
Column headers: RANK 1 / BASE; RANK 2 / 1 SP; RANK 3 / 2 SP; RANK 4 / 3 SP; RANK 5 / 4 SP; CAPSTONE / AUTO · FREE.
Weapon: Seven Dwarves; Marked Rounds; Afterburn; Burning + Slow; Charging; Unyielding. First FOUR checked.
Special: Auto-Turret; Expanded Arsenal; Defensive Line; Incendiary Arsenal; Permanent Emplacement; Detonation. First THREE checked.
Burst: Seven Dwarves; Fully Active; Focused Fire; Pierce + Stun; A Century of Prep Time; A Goddess Who Cannot Yield. Only FIRST checked.
All capstones remain LOCKED with "AT RANK 5"; Unyielding selected for preview.
Bottom: "WEAPON · CAPSTONE", "UNYIELDING", "Bullet kills: 20% chance to restore 1 HP.", "Unlocks automatically at Weapon Rank 5."
Button "UPGRADE WEAPON · 4 SP"; subline "Rank 4 → 5: Charging + Unyielding".
Footer "Earn SP by leveling up. Spend on any ability. Capstones unlock at Rank 5." and "TAB RESUME".

This should feel like the same approved menu after a careful shape cleanup. Its structure must be calmer and more square. Do not add diagrams, callouts, explanations, websites, or side-by-side comparison panels to the image. Output ONE full game UI screenshot.
Preserve Image 1's ultrawide 21:9 aspect ratio and exact framing.
